description: Reduced configuration of b7_inverse.json for scripts/smoke_test.py: 10 observations, 32 collocation nodes, 150 + 20 optimiser iterations, two realisations, two least-squares starts. The numbers obtained with it are not reported anywhere. The mesh keys of the least-squares fits keep their names (N128, N512) because the drivers refer to them; their sizes are reduced.

pilot.selection: per (design, noise level): the weight with the smallest median over the pilot realisations of the root-mean-square relative parameter error
